items.detalle: Preparation, filler where needed, rust-inhibiting spot-prime and finish coats
Treated on the agreed exposed surfaces

items.descripcion: Elevator-front floor areas, including white perimeter curbs
items.detalle: Surface prep and two finish coats of floor coating; curbs repainted white

notaPrecios: Pricing includes all labor and materials for the scope described in this proposal. Any change in scope or unforeseen concealed condition will be quoted separately for written approval.

alcance.texto: Clean and prepare 8 standard metal doors and their frames, plus 3 louvered / ventilation doors. Standard doors and frames are included; ventilation doors are treated on the agreed exposed surfaces.
pasos: Clean and prepare all door surfaces
Remove loose paint and accessible surface rust
Apply compatible metal filler/putty and additional sanding to localized damaged areas where appropriate
Spot-prime exposed metal with rust-inhibiting primer
notas: More deteriorated doors may require additional localized cosmetic preparation, included in the quoted price.

aviso.texto: Metal filler, sanding, patching, and any agreed cosmetic lower-panel treatment improve surface appearance but do not replace damaged metal, restore structural strength, or stop corrosion originating inside severely compromised sections. Replacement of door leaves, frames, or structural components is not included.

alcance.texto: Prepare two existing coated floor areas and repaint the associated perimeter curbs white.
pasos: Mechanically abrade sound existing coating to promote adhesion
Repair minor surface imperfections as practical
Apply compatible primer if required by the selected system
Apply two finish coats of a suitable floor coating, subject to product instructions and substrate condition
excluye: Full removal of sound existing coating

productos.producto: Sherwin-Williams Pro Industrial Pro-Cryl Universal Metal Primer

productos.nota: Exact SKU and sheen to be confirmed.
Final system subject to substrate compatibility.

sistema.nota: Exact manufacturer color codes will be documented after on-site color matching and before application. B66/B90 are product-family identifiers, not color codes.

cronograma.texto: Within 24 hours after the 30% deposit has cleared, subject to authorized building access and permitted working hours (Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.). If funds clear outside an allowable work window, mobilization begins in the next permitted work window.
Approximately 5 working days, subject to surface conditions, weather, coating cure/recoat times and access.
Completion before the inspection depends on timely payment and uninterrupted access.

garantia.texto: Colores Santos LLC warrants its workmanship for 12 months from completion against paint peeling, lifting, or premature adhesion failure directly caused by deficient preparation or application by Colores Santos. At its discretion, Colores Santos will inspect and correct verified covered workmanship defects in the affected area.
noCubre: Pre-existing coating failure outside the prepared scope
garantia.nota: No structural repair or replacement warranty is provided.

aprobacion.texto: Approval authorizes the above defined scope and pricing. Changes to scope or unforeseen concealed conditions requiring replacement or substantial restoration will be quoted separately for written approval before additional work.
